Kaprekar Constant Multibase Results

Code Python

'''Here are the kaprekar attractors for bases from 2 to 64,
To read this data:
Each box comes for a base,
Inside of which box you'll have 
sucessive results for progressive
number of digits.
In each case, the result is the kaprekar
attractor: it can be
- 0
- some number
- a loop
this attractor is at the left end of the line
then, there is the number of occurences of this
attactor in the current base,
then this number of occurences turned into a
percentage,
then, if the attractor happens to be a loop,
the loop is printed to the right, outside the box.
(it will continue to the next line of course on 
small screens)
